note: The input line selects SVCB record parsing, so the input-controlled SvcParams are encoded into the scanner r_data output buffer.
The parser iterates over the input-controlled SVCB parameter list while rdata_tail advances through the fixed-size r_data buffer.
Each IPv6 hint appends 16 bytes to r_data, but the SVCB value production has no total remaining-capacity guard before accepting another address.
When enough input-controlled IPv6 hints are parsed, rdata_tail points beyond the scanner r_data array and the address memcpy writes past the output buffer.
